<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>SetNet.Locomotion</id>
    <version>1.6.0</version>
    <authors>Artem Lemeshev</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet</projectUrl>
    <description>A unified server-side movement simulator for SetNet: one system advances the position of everything that moves (players, mobs, NPCs, projectiles) along pathfound routes at a fixed rate — with automatic subscription (create a Mover and it's already ticking). It replicates NOTHING: you read positions and replicate them your own way, and a Started hook fires when a mover gets a new destination so you can send just the point to clients (L2-style, client re-paths locally). Depends on SetNet + SetNet.GeoData + SetNet.PathFinding.</description>
    <tags>networking movement locomotion pathfinding mmo game setnet</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet.git" commit="c41260bf2799ebe894dc42712c4130add212e52d" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="SetNet" version="1.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="SetNet.GeoData" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="SetNet.PathFinding" version="1.3.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="SetNet.Ticks" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
